svg.title: Handwritten study note: if and else
svg.desc: A ruled-paper note showing how a true or false condition chooses an if or else branch.

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: Quick note: let the condition choose the path

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: if (condition) → run this block when true

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: else → otherwise, run the other block

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: else if (...) → check another condition in order

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive

svg.text: Tip: conditions are tested top to bottom!
